club: Maples Tech Club (MTC) — Learn it. Build it. Ship it.

questions.question_text: Which key at the top-left of the keyboard is commonly pressed to cancel a pop-up or exit full-screen video?
Which function key is the classic shortcut to REFRESH or reload a webpage in a browser?
If you pressed Ctrl + Z (Undo) by mistake and want your change back, which shortcut performs REDO?
Which keyboard shortcut lets you quickly switch between open apps/windows on Windows?
To type a single capital letter or the "@" symbol above the number 2 without turning on Caps Lock, which key do you hold?
Which shortcut opens a brand-new blank document or window in most apps?
In a web browser like Chrome or Edge, what does pressing Ctrl + T do?
In a web browser, what does pressing Ctrl + W do?
Which key on a Windows keyboard is used to capture a screenshot of your entire screen?
When a file or folder is selected on Windows, pressing which function key lets you RENAME it immediately?
What does pressing Alt + F4 do on a Windows computer?
questions.option_b: Closes the currently active app or window

questions.question_text: In a browser, pressing Ctrl and the "+" (plus) key together does what?
questions.option_a: Zooms in to make text and images appear larger

questions.question_text: After zooming in on a webpage, pressing Ctrl + 0 (zero) does what?
questions.option_d: Resets the page zoom back to normal (100%)

questions.question_text: When filling out an online form (like Name, Roll No, Class), pressing the Tab key usually does what?
questions.option_c: Moves the cursor neatly to the next input box

questions.question_text: If you step away from a computer for a minute, which Windows shortcut immediately LOCKS your screen?
Which Windows shortcut minimizes all open windows at once so you can see the Desktop?
You accidentally closed an important tab in Chrome/Edge! Which lifesaver shortcut reopens the last closed tab?
What happens when you delete a file using Shift + Delete instead of just pressing Delete?
questions.option_b: It moves the file to Desktop
questions.option_d: It permanently deletes the file without sending it to the Recycle Bin

questions.question_text: Which single modern cable carries BOTH sharp high-definition video AND audio from a laptop to a TV or projector?
At a supermarket checkout or school library, which handheld device reads black-and-white striped labels instantly?
Why can a laptop keep running during a power cut even without an external UPS?
questions.option_a: Laptops have a built-in rechargeable battery inside

questions.question_text: What is the tiny removable storage card used inside many cameras and Android phones called?
What is the main job of the small spinning fan inside a laptop or desktop cabinet?
questions.option_c: To keep the processor and internal parts cool so the computer does not overheat
questions.option_d: To blow dust onto the screen

questions.question_text: In everyday phones and computers, what is the simple difference between RAM and Storage (SSD/ROM)?
questions.option_a: RAM stores photos forever; Storage deletes everything on restart
questions.option_b: Both are names for the screen
questions.option_d: RAM holds active apps temporarily while working; Storage keeps your photos and files saved even when powered off

questions.question_text: If your computer opens 15 browser tabs and starts feeling sluggish when switching apps, having more of which part helps most?
Modern laptops use an SSD instead of an older spinning Hard Disk (HDD). What everyday benefit do you notice right away?
questions.option_c: The laptop boots up and opens apps much faster, with no moving disk parts
questions.option_d: You never need to charge the battery

questions.question_text: Which newer oval-shaped reversible charging/data port is found on almost all modern Android phones and newer laptops?
What do we call the main circuit board inside a computer that connects the processor, RAM, storage, and ports together?
If a wireless mouse stops moving the cursor on screen, what is the FIRST simple hardware thing you should check?
questions.option_a: Check if its battery is low or its tiny power switch underneath is turned OFF

questions.question_text: A pen-like tool used by digital artists and students to write or draw neatly on a tablet screen is called a:
Which storage capacity is LARGER when comparing a pendrive or laptop storage?
Roughly how many Gigabytes (GB) make 1 Terabyte (TB) on a hard drive?
Before pulling out a USB pendrive while files are copying, why should you wait or click "Eject"?
questions.option_b: Otherwise the monitor turns black forever
questions.option_c: Pulling it out mid-write can corrupt or damage the files being saved

questions.question_text: Which computer component is specially helpful for smooth 3D video editing, animation, and modern games?
Why should you NEVER block the air vents on the bottom of a laptop by placing it deep into a thick blanket for hours?
questions.option_a: It makes the screen brightness drop to zero
questions.option_d: Blocked vents trap heat inside, causing overheating, slow performance, and battery wear

questions.question_text: A desktop monitor is turned ON, its power light is blinking, and it says "No Signal." What is the most likely practical cause?
questions.option_b: Either the CPU cabinet is OFF or the HDMI/VGA display cable between the CPU and monitor is loose
questions.option_c: Caps Lock is pressed on the keyboard

questions.question_text: Which application is best suited for keeping an attendance list, marks table, or club budget with automatic totals?
What is the difference between "Copy & Paste" and "Cut & Paste" on a file?
questions.option_b: Copy leaves the original file in place and makes a duplicate; Cut moves the file to the new folder

questions.question_text: What is a ".zip" file commonly used for when sharing a project?
questions.option_c: Bundling many files/folders together into one smaller compressed file for easy sending

questions.question_text: In Word or Google Docs, what is the difference between "Save" and "Save As"?
questions.option_a: Both print the document on paper
questions.option_d: "Save" updates the current file; "Save As" lets you save a separate copy with a new name or location

questions.question_text: Which long bar at the bottom of a Windows screen shows the Start button, pinned apps, and clock?
Why do many students turn on "Dark Mode" in apps when reading or working in the evening?
questions.option_b: It uses a dark background that feels gentler on the eyes in low light
questions.option_c: It makes Wi-Fi twice as fast
questions.option_d: It prints pages in black paper

questions.question_text: If you want to jot down a quick plain-text note with zero heavy formatting, which lightweight built-in Windows app opens instantly?
When saving an image with a transparent background (such as a school logo), which image format supports transparency cleanly?
On Windows, files ending in ".exe" (or ".apk" on Android) are what kind of files?
questions.option_a: Application installer / executable program files (only run from trusted official sources!)

questions.question_text: Before editing an important project presentation, why is naming files clearly like "Science_Poster_v2_Final.pptx" better than "asdf123.pptx"?
questions.option_a: Computers refuse to save short names
questions.option_b: Clear file names let you and your teammates find the right version in seconds without confusion

questions.question_text: What does the "Spell Check" wavy red underline in Word or Google Docs indicate?
questions.option_a: That the sentence will be deleted automatically
questions.option_c: A word that may have a spelling typo so you can review and fix it
questions.option_d: That the computer has a virus

questions.question_text: If a single app stops responding ("Not Responding") on Windows, how can you close JUST that stuck app without unplugging the whole PC?
questions.option_c: Pull the electric plug from the wall
questions.option_d: Open Task Manager, select the frozen app, and click "End Task"

questions.question_text: What is "Open-Source Software" (such as Linux, VLC, Blender, or LibreOffice)?
questions.option_a: Software that leaves your computer unlocked to strangers
questions.option_b: Software that works only for 1 hour
questions.option_d: Software whose source code is openly shared so anyone can use, study, and improve it legally

questions.question_text: When you install a new PDF app and Windows asks which "Default App" should open .pdf files, what does that setting control?
questions.option_b: Which program opens automatically whenever you double-click any .pdf file

questions.question_text: In Google Docs or Microsoft 365 Online, what is a huge everyday advantage of "Auto-Save" to the cloud?
questions.option_b: It writes your homework by itself
questions.option_c: Your latest edits are saved continuously, so a sudden power cut does not wipe out an hour of typing
questions.option_d: It works without turning on the screen

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of Windows Security / Antivirus software on a PC?
questions.option_a: To detect and block harmful malware or infected downloads before they damage your files
questions.option_d: To clean physical dust off the keyboard

questions.question_text: Why do phones and laptops let you turn off unnecessary "Startup Apps" in Settings?
questions.option_a: Fewer heavy apps launching automatically at boot makes the computer start up faster and saves memory
questions.option_d: It turns off the screen color

questions.question_text: When you download a `.zip` archive of club photos, why should you "Extract All" before editing the photos inside?
questions.option_a: Otherwise the photos turn black and white
questions.option_b: Extracting unpacks the compressed files into a normal folder so apps can open and save changes properly

questions.question_text: What does opening an "Incognito" or "Private" browser window ACTUALLY do on a shared computer?
questions.option_a: It makes you completely invisible to websites and your internet provider
questions.option_b: It stops the browser from saving your browsing history, cookies, and login session on THAT computer after you close the window
questions.option_c: It blocks all computer viruses automatically
questions.option_d: It gives free unlimited mobile data

questions.question_text: If a webpage shows "404 — Page Not Found", what does that simply mean?
questions.option_c: The specific link or page was moved, deleted, or typed with a spelling mistake

questions.question_text: When writing a polite email to a teacher or competition organizer, why should you always fill in the "Subject" line?
questions.option_b: Subject is where you type your password
questions.option_c: Emails cannot be sent without 50 words in Subject
questions.option_d: So the receiver immediately knows what your email is about before even opening it

questions.question_text: If an expected registration confirmation email has not arrived in your Inbox, which email folder should you check next?
Why do websites sometimes ask you to tick "I am not a robot" or pick traffic lights (CAPTCHA)?
questions.option_b: To stop automated spam bots from creating fake accounts or flooding forms
questions.option_c: To test your eyesight for driving

questions.question_text: In Chrome or Edge, which shortcut opens your recent Downloads list directly inside the browser?
What are website "Cookies" in everyday browsing?
questions.option_a: Tiny text files saved by websites in your browser to remember things like your login status or dark-mode preference

questions.question_text: In Google Search, putting quotation marks around an exact phrase like `"Maples Academy Khatauli"` helps you find:
questions.option_a: Pages containing that exact phrase with those words together in that order
questions.option_c: Pages that do NOT mention Maples Academy

questions.question_text: What is Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive an example of?
questions.option_a: A physical pendrive inside your pocket
questions.option_b: Cloud storage — lets you save files online and open or share them from any phone or computer

questions.question_text: When sharing a Google Drive project link with your teacher, why should you check whether access is set to "Restricted" vs "Anyone with the link can View"?
questions.option_a: View access lets anyone delete your account
questions.option_c: If left "Restricted", your teacher will see "Access Denied" when clicking your submitted link!

questions.question_text: On a noisy browser tab playing unexpected music, what does the tiny speaker icon on that tab let you see or do?
questions.option_d: Spot immediately which tab is playing sound and even mute that tab

questions.question_text: What does an email ending in `.edu.in`, `.ac.in`, or `.gov.in` in India tell you about the website/sender?
questions.option_a: Anyone can buy it anonymously for ₹10 without verification
questions.option_d: It belongs to a verified Indian educational institution (`.edu.in`/`.ac.in`) or government body (`.gov.in`)

questions.question_text: If you start writing an email in Gmail and close the tab before clicking Send, where is your unfinished message saved automatically?
What is a "Browser Extension" (or Add-on)?
questions.option_c: A small optional helper tool added inside your browser (which you should install ONLY from trusted creators)

questions.question_text: If you want to save an online exam admit card or receipt neatly so you can view it offline anytime without internet, what can you select in the Print (`Ctrl + P`) destination menu?
When a random flashy website suddenly asks "Allow this site to send you Notifications?", what is the smart habit if you do not need alerts from it?
questions.option_a: Click "Block" — allowing shady sites to send notifications floods your screen with fake virus/ad pop-ups!
questions.option_b: Always click Allow on every site

questions.question_text: When sending an email announcement to 50 parents or students who do not know each other, why is `BCC` better than `CC`?
questions.option_b: `BCC` (Blind Carbon Copy) keeps everyone’s email address private from the other recipients

questions.question_text: In an email thread sent to 40 club members, what happens if you click "Reply All" instead of "Reply"?
questions.option_c: Your reply goes to ALL 40 people in the group instead of just the sender!

questions.question_text: Internet plan speeds from providers like JioFiber, Airtel, or BSNL are commonly advertised in "100 Mbps". What does Mbps measure?
questions.option_b: How far the Wi-Fi reaches in meters
questions.option_c: Megabits per second — how fast data transfers over your internet connection
questions.option_d: How many months the plan lasts

questions.question_text: Companies like BSNL, Airtel, Jio, or local fiber broadband providers that connect homes/schools to the internet are called:
Why does Wi-Fi signal become weaker when you walk three rooms away behind thick concrete walls?
questions.option_d: Thick walls and distance absorb and weaken wireless radio waves from the router

questions.question_text: What is a "Local Area Network (LAN)" in simple everyday words?
questions.option_b: Computers, laptops, and printers connected together inside one building, home, or school campus

questions.question_text: If ONE Wi-Fi printer is connected to the school office Wi-Fi router, how many computers on that same Wi-Fi can print to it?
questions.option_a: Only phones with no SIM card
questions.option_c: All authorized computers/phones on that same Wi-Fi network can share and print to it wirelessly
questions.option_d: Only a computer plugged into it with an HDMI cable

questions.question_text: When you mirror your phone or laptop screen wirelessly onto a classroom Smart TV without any cable, what is that feature called?
Every device connected to a network gets an identifying number address (like a house number for delivering data packets). What is it called?
You are using a 1.5 GB/day mobile data pack via Hotspot. Watching 2 hours of video at `4K / 2160p` vs `480p` will do what?
questions.option_b: `4K` uses many times more mobile data and can finish your 1.5 GB pack very quickly!

questions.question_text: On a laptop connected to someone’s mobile Hotspot, turning ON "Metered Connection" (or Data Saver) helps because:
questions.option_c: It pauses huge background Windows updates so your friend’s mobile data does not drain suddenly

questions.question_text: On modern dual-band home Wi-Fi routers, you often see two Wi-Fi names: `Home_2.4G` and `Home_5G`. What is the practical difference?
questions.option_a: There is no difference at all
questions.option_c: `5G` Wi-Fi requires a 5G SIM card inside the router
questions.option_d: `5 GHz` gives faster speeds nearby in the same room; `2.4 GHz` reaches farther through walls

questions.question_text: What is "Quick Share / Nearby Share / AirDrop" on modern phones and laptops used for?
questions.option_a: Charging another phone from 10 meters away
questions.option_d: Sending photos or project files fast between two nearby devices wirelessly without wasting internet data

questions.question_text: Why should you avoid logging into banking or sensitive accounts on an open, password-free public Wi-Fi at a railway station or café?
questions.option_a: Public Wi-Fi breaks your phone camera
questions.option_b: Unsecured open Wi-Fi networks make it easier for attackers nearby to snoop on traffic or set up fake twin hotspots

questions.question_text: In online video calls or multiplayer games, what does "High Ping / High Latency" (e.g., 450 ms instead of 25 ms) feel like?
questions.option_c: A noticeable delay or lag between clicking/speaking and getting a response back

questions.question_text: What brings ultrahigh-speed broadband into modern schools and homes using hair-thin strands of glass carrying pulses of light?
If the home internet suddenly stops working on ALL phones and laptops at once, what safe 1-minute step often resolves a stuck router?
questions.option_a: Power-cycle the router: turn it OFF, wait 15–30 seconds, and turn it back ON
questions.option_b: Factory-reset every phone in the house

questions.question_text: What does "NFC" (Near Field Communication) on modern phones and smart cards allow?
questions.option_b: Tap-to-pay or instant pairing when held within a few centimeters of a reader/tag

questions.question_text: When you type `mapleskhatauli.com` in your browser, which behind-the-scenes internet phonebook translates that friendly name into the server’s numeric IP address?
Your internet speed test shows `100 Mbps` (Megabits per second). Since 8 bits = 1 Byte, roughly how many Megabytes (`MB`) can download in 1 second?
Why is reusing the EXACT SAME password across 10 different games, websites, and your main email risky?
questions.option_b: It uses extra storage on your phone
questions.option_d: If even one small game site gets hacked, attackers immediately try that same password on your email and other accounts!

questions.question_text: How should a responsible student use AI tools (like ChatGPT or Gemini) when working on a project or assignment?
questions.option_a: Copy-paste the entire AI output without reading a word and sign it as 100% your own
questions.option_b: Trust every single date or quote from AI without checking
questions.option_d: Use AI to brainstorm, understand tough ideas, or debug — then write/build in your own understanding and honestly mention where AI helped

questions.question_text: You install a simple "Flashlight" app on a phone, and it suddenly asks permission to read your Contacts, Call Logs, and Messages. What should you think?
questions.option_a: Flashlights need your contacts to shine brighter
questions.option_b: Deny/uninstall! A flashlight only needs the camera LED — asking for private contacts and messages is a big privacy red flag

questions.question_text: What is "Phishing"?
questions.option_c: Fake emails, SMS, or look-alike websites pretending to be a trusted bank/company to trick you into typing passwords or OTPs

questions.question_text: What does your "Digital Footprint" mean?
questions.option_a: The lasting trail of posts, comments, photos, and public activity associated with you on the internet
questions.option_c: The size of your laptop in inches
questions.option_d: Walking barefoot in the computer lab

questions.question_text: Why is downloading "Cracked / Pirated" paid software or game cheats from shady websites dangerous as well as unethical?
questions.option_a: Besides disrespecting creators’ work, pirated cracks are one of the #1 ways password-stealing malware infects home PCs!
questions.option_b: Cracked software runs faster and safer than official apps
questions.option_d: Official free alternatives like VLC, GIMP, or LibreOffice do not exist

questions.question_text: Before clicking "Save Password" when Chrome asks on a shared school or cyber-café computer, what should you ALWAYS choose?
questions.option_a: Click "Save" so you never have to type again
questions.option_b: Click "Never" — saving your password on a shared computer lets the next person log straight into your account!
questions.option_c: Share it with the café owner
questions.option_d: Write your password on a sticky note on the monitor

questions.question_text: In a class study WhatsApp/Telegram group, what keeps the group helpful and respectful for everyone?
questions.option_a: Starting personal arguments in front of 60 people
questions.option_c: Keeping messages relevant, polite, avoiding late-night spam chains, and respecting classmates’ opinions
questions.option_d: Sending 80 stickers in a row at midnight

questions.question_text: Why do phones and Windows regularly release "Security Updates"?
questions.option_d: To patch newly discovered security holes so hackers and malware cannot exploit them

questions.question_text: If a classmate accidentally left their Gmail open on a school lab computer, what is the ONLY ethical thing to do?
questions.option_a: Read their private emails for fun
questions.option_b: Send a prank email from their account
questions.option_d: Immediately click "Sign Out" without reading a single email, and politely let them know to be careful next time

questions.question_text: Sometimes AI chatbots confidently make up a fake book title, date, or fact that sounds very believable. What should you do before putting AI facts into a school project?
questions.option_b: Verify important facts, dates, and quotes from a reliable textbook or trusted official website
questions.option_c: Assume computers can never be wrong

questions.question_text: Why is keeping phones on silent and putting screens away at least 30–45 minutes before sleep recommended by doctors?
questions.option_c: Bright late-night screens and endless notifications disturb deep sleep and leave you tired in class the next morning

questions.question_text: If you receive an uncomfortable, threatening, or scam message from an unknown account online, what 3 steps protect you best?
questions.option_a: Do NOT reply or argue — take a screenshot as proof if needed, Block/Report the account, and tell a trusted parent or teacher
questions.option_c: Keep it secret and worry alone
questions.option_d: Send them your phone number to argue back

questions.question_text: What is "Plagiarism" in school projects and digital work?
questions.option_a: Copying someone else’s article, code, or artwork and presenting it as your own original work without credit
questions.option_b: Saving a backup copy on a pendrive

questions.question_text: When sitting at a computer desk for an hour, what healthy posture avoids neck and back ache?
questions.option_a: Bend your neck 90 degrees inches from the keyboard
questions.option_b: Sit upright with feet flat, shoulders relaxed, and top of the screen near eye level rather than hunching low
questions.option_c: Keep the monitor on the floor

questions.question_text: What is India’s official national Cyber Crime Helpline number (and portal `cybercrime.gov.in`) in case a family member faces online financial fraud?
What is a "Deepfake" video or voice clip that everyone on social media needs to be aware of today?
questions.option_b: A backup stored deep inside a folder
questions.option_d: An AI-manipulated video or cloned voice that makes a real person appear to say or do something they NEVER actually did

questions.question_text: Someone calls your parent in panic using a realistic-sounding voice saying "Send ₹10,000 urgently to this new number, don’t tell anyone!" What is the smart verification habit?
questions.option_a: Transfer money within 10 seconds in panic
questions.option_b: Share bank OTPs on the call
questions.option_c: Install a screen-sharing app they suggest
questions.option_d: Pause, hang up, and call the family member directly on their REAL known phone number to verify before sending a rupee!
